component.name: IP Tool for AXIS (Linux)
component.summary: Find and set up Axis network cameras

description.p: Finds Axis devices on the local network (Bonjour/mDNS and SSDP) and performs the basic setup known from the AXIS IP Utility:

ul.li: Monitor devices continuously: ping, login status, IPv6 address and network interface
Create the first administrator on devices in factory default state and set power line frequency and mounting position
Configure IPv4 (DHCP or static), hostname and DNS
Set time zone, NTP servers or synchronise the clock
Live view with PTZ control, zoom/focus, autofocus and lens calibration
Configure many devices at once: sequential IP addresses, numbered host names or a CSV plan
Open the web interface (also via link-local IPv6), restart devices or reset them to factory defaults

description.p: Not an official product of Axis Communications AB.

screenshot.caption: Discovered cameras with status, IPv6 address and ping

description.p: Renamed to IP Tool for AXIS (Linux), with a new package name, Flatpak ID and CLI command. Adds camera firmware updates, live view with PTZ and lens controls, and an app update notice at startup. See the project README for migration from the old package.

English user interface. Continuous monitoring with ping and status, IPv6 address and interface columns, web interface via link-local IPv6, power line frequency and mounting position at commissioning, more reliable factory state detection. License changed to AGPL-3.0-or-later.
Configure many devices at once, login status with password check, factory reset, host name column.
First release: discovery, initial password, network, time/NTP, snapshot preview.
